notes.title: Adressing the Negative Reviews - Update 1.5.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I hope you're all doing well!

I just wanted to say a big thank you for all your constructive reviews. I’ve read every single one—especially the critical ones—and I really appreciate the feedback. I always try to improve the game based on what you share, though sometimes that means making tough decisions that slightly shift the original vision.

That said, I’ve come to realize that sometimes the players are right, and as a developer, I have to set my own creative ideas aside to make a better experience.

In version 1.5.0:


 Removed three filler levels (Fourteenth, Twenty-Third, and Twenty-Fifth)
 Polished a couple of levels for a smoother experience
 Added a brand new chase animation for the lady in the Eighteenth loop — it's much more alive now, and way creepier


I’ll continue working on polishing the game and adding new elements, with the goal of eventually reaching a possible 2.0 release.

Thanks again for reading. If you’d like to help out or just chat, feel free to reach out via email or X.

Take care and enjoy the game! :D
